_comment: BSData lag corrections for the 10th edition Wahapedia codex. Layered into load_catalog BETWEEN the BSData base and overrides.json (see code/bsdata/loader.py:load_catalog docstring). Each entry restores a canonical codex value that BSData's main branch still carries at the pre-errata value. Distinct from overrides.json which holds SwegHammer hand-tuning / proxies. When a BSData refresh fixes a corrected value upstream, the entry here can be retired by checking that bsdata_was no longer matches the parsed value.
_bsdata_snapshot: main branch fetched 2026-05-18 (see data/bsdata/cache/ timestamps); SwegHammer DEFAULT_TAG in code/bsdata/fetch.py is currently 'main' so the snapshot is not version-locked. Pinning to a stable BSData tag is a separate piece of work (parking lot).

aeldari_craftworlds_corsair_voidscarred.errata: BSData mapper attributed Anti-Infantry 2+ to the wrong weapon profile. Sim's primary weapon for this unit is Shuriken Pistol (Strength 4, AP -1, Damage 1), which on the current Wahapedia datasheet has only [ASSAULT] and [PISTOL] keywords. The Anti-Infantry 2+ in the BSData parse appears to have leaked from the Executioner profile (which legitimately carries Anti-Infantry 2+) onto the Shuriken Pistol entry. Since the sim's recorded weapon name and stats match the Shuriken Pistol, the corrective action is to clear anti_keywords on that profile.
aeldari_craftworlds_corsair_voidscarred.notes: Verified weapons on the Wahapedia Voidscarred datasheet: Shuriken Pistol (no anti-keyword), Neuro Disruptor (Anti-Infantry 2+), Executioner (Anti-Infantry 2+, Psychic). Kharseth's Dread of the Deep Void, Troupe Master's Neuro Disruptor secondary, and Shadowseer's Neuro Disruptor all legitimately retain Anti-Infantry 2+ per current codex and need no correction.

deathwatch_watch_master.errata: BSData mapper failed to parse the Watch Master's 4+ invulnerable save into a structured invuln_save field. The Deathwatch catalogue file carries the invuln as an ability text profile ("This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.") rather than a numeric characteristic, so the parser left invuln_save at the no-invuln sentinel of 7. Wahapedia confirms Watch Master has Invulnerable Save: 4+ in current 10e codex.
deathwatch_watch_master.notes: Same structural mapper gap also affects deathwatch_watch_captain_artemis (also invuln 7 in parsed.json, should be 4+) and likely Chaplain Cassius / Garran Branatar in the Deathwatch catalogue. Only Watch Master is in the current audit's target list; Artemis correction left for a future sweep. Wahapedia datasheet retrieved 2026-05-28; no Deathwatch-specific faction page exists, datasheet is hosted under imperial-agents.

_audit_log.action: Added 8 Dark Angels BSData-lag corrections for missing invulnerable saves
_audit_log.evidence: Audited 8 load-bearing Dark Angels units (Azrael, Belial, Sammael, Asmodai, Lion El'Jonson, Deathwing Knights, Ravenwing Black Knights, Ezekiel) against Wahapedia 10e datasheets. All 8 have invuln_save=7 (no invuln) in BSData parsed.json. The Dark Angels catalogue (Imperium - Dark Angels.cat.gz) encodes invulnerable saves as inline <profile typeName="Abilities"> elements with a Description characteristic — the same structural pattern as the Chaos Daemons Library batch from wave-47 CODEX-STALE-DAEMONS. mapper.extract_invuln() only walks infoLinks and entryLink chains, missing the inline-profile encoding entirely. Wahapedia confirms: Azrael 4+, Belial 4+, Sammael 4+, Asmodai 4+, Ezekiel 4+, Deathwing Knights 4+, Lion El'Jonson 3+ (The Emperor's Shield), Ravenwing Black Knights 5+. No overrides.json entries for Dark Angels exist, so no shadow-removal needed (mirrors Karanak fix is not applicable here). Wahapedia DNS resolved successfully from worktree.

_audit_log.action: Added 1 Deathwatch correction for unparsed invulnerable save
_audit_log.evidence: Audited 5 Deathwatch-unique tournament-relevant units (Watch Master, Deathwatch Veterans, Corvus Blackstar, Indomitor Kill Team, Proteus Kill Team). Proteus Kill Team only exists as a Legends entry under Agents of the Imperium and was skipped. Wahapedia hosts current Deathwatch datasheets under imperial-agents (no deathwatch faction page). Veterans, Corvus Blackstar and Indomitor Kill Team weapon stats matched Wahapedia within basket-blend tolerance. Watch Master's 4+ invulnerable save is recorded as ability text in the Deathwatch catalogue file and the mapper does not parse it, leaving invuln_save at the no-invuln sentinel of 7 in parsed.json. Wahapedia confirms 4+ invuln in current codex.

_audit_log.action: Added 7 BSData-lag corrections for Chaos Daemons invulnerable saves; removed wrong Karanak override from overrides.json

Behavioural impact mostly zero (overrides.json hand-patched same values) except Karanak which had wrong 5+ override; corrections layer 4+ now applies after override removal.
